summary: The PR removes the safety check for `user.address` in `getUserCity`, introducing a regression where passing a user object without an address property (or with a null/undefined address) will throw a runtime TypeError.

findings.title: Unchecked property access on null or undefined address
findings.description: Removing the check `if (!user.address)` causes `getUserCity` to throw a `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'city')` when `user` lacks an `address` property or `user.address` is null/undefined.
findings.verificationHypothesis: If `getUserCity` is invoked with a user object where `address` is missing or null (e.g., `{ name: 'John' }`), it will throw a TypeError instead of returning null.

suggestedReproduction.preconditions: The input user object does not contain an address property.
suggestedReproduction.expectedBehavior: Returns null or undefined without throwing an exception.
suggestedReproduction.suspiciousBehavior: Throws TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'city').
